title: Profiling the binding sites of RNA-binding protein by LACE-seq
protocol: Resuspend HeLa cells, K562 cells, or mouse oocytes in PBS.
Pick a specific number of cells to a 1.5 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube using needles under a microscope.
Spin down the cells to the bottom with an IKA mini G centrifuge.
Quickly put the tube on ice after spinning down the cells.
Irradiate cells at 400 mJ with UV-C light on ice for two times.
Mix the protein A/G magnetic beads thoroughly before use.
Place 10 µl of beads for each sample into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl of BSA/PBS solution (0.1% BSA in 1×PBS).
Block beads with 200 µl of blocking buffer at room temperature for 1 h by rotating at 20 rpm.
Place the microcentrifuge tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant after placing the tube on a magnetic stand.
Wash the blocked beads once with 200 µl of Na-phosphate buffer.
Resuspend washed beads with 40 µl of Na-phosphate buffer containing 2 µg specific antibody.
Rotate the tube at 20 rpm for 1 h at RT.
Spin down the beads to the bottom of the microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl of wash buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 10 µl of wash buffer for each sample.
Leave the beads on ice.
Lose cross-linked cells with 50 µl of wash buffer on ice for 10 minutes.
Add 1 µl of SUPERase·In RNase inhibitor to the cell lysate.
Add 4 µl of RQ1 DNase to the cell lysate and digest genomic DNA at 37 °C for 3 minutes in ThermoMixer C.
Snap-chill the tube on ice for 3 minutes.
Aliquot 10 µl of antibody-coupled beads into cell lysate prepared previously.
Rotate at 20 rpm for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Spin briefly and place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with 200 µl of ice-cold wash buffer.
Wash the beads once with 200 µl of high-salt wash buffer.
Wash the beads once with 200 µl of PNK buffer.
Dilute MNase 1:1000 by mixing 0.5 μl of MNase with 499.5 μl of 1 × MN buffer.
Sequentially dilute MNase 1:3000 to 1:6000 by mixing 0.5 µl of diluted MNase with corresponding volumes of 1 × MN buffer.
Add 10 µl of the diluted MNase to the beads and incubate at 37 °C for 3 minutes.
Add 200 μl of 1 × PNK + EGTA buffer to the tube.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant and wash the beads once with 1 × PNK + EGTA buffer.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of wash buffer.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of PNK buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl of FastAP mixture (including 2 μl 10 × FastAP buffer, 1 μl FastAP alkaline phosphatase, and 17 μl water).
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes with intermittent mixing every 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and wash the beads twice with 200 μl of 1 × PNK + EGTA buffer.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of PNK buffer.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of BSA solution (0.2 mg/ml in DEPC-treated water).
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl of ligation mixture (including 12.5 μl water, 2 μl 10 × ligation buffer, 0.5 μl 3’ linker at 1 µM, 1 μl T4 RNA ligase 2, and 4 μl 50% PEG8000).
Incubate the mixture at 25 °C for 2.5 hours with intermittent vortexing every 3 minutes.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand for 1 minute.
Discard the supernatant and wash beads three times with PNK buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 8.5 μl of DEPC-treated water and 1 μl of T7-RT primer (0.5-100 nM).
Transfer the 9.5 µl beads mixture to a new PCR tube.
Heat the PCR tube at 65 °C for 5 min.
Snap-chill the PCR tube on ice for 2 min.
Add RT mixture (3 µl of 5 × first-strand buffer, 0.5 µl of 0.1 M DTT, 0.5 µl of Superscript II, 0.5 µl of RNase inhibitor, and 1 µl of dNTP mix) to the PCR tube.
Mix the PCR tube by pipetting up and down for 20 times.
Incubate the PCR tube at 42 °C for 50 min.
Incubate the PCR tube at 70 °C for 15 min.
Hold the PCR tube at 12 °C in a thermal cycler.
Add 2 µl of 10 × Exonuclease I buffer to the PCR tube.
Add 3 µl of Exonuclease I mixture directly into the PCR tube.
Mix the PCR tube thoroughly.
Incubate the PCR tube at 37 °C for 1 h.
Incubate the PCR tube at 80 °C for 20 min.
Release the first-strand cDNA from Protein A/G beads by adding 10 µl of RNase H reaction mixture (3 µl of 10 × RNase H buffer, 1 µl of RNase H, and 6 µl of water) to the PCR tube.
Mix the PCR tube briefly.
Incubate the PCR tube at 37 °C for 30 min.
Incubate the PCR tube at 65 °C for 20 min in a thermal cycler.
Place the PCR tube on a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube.
Keep the tube on ice and wait for the addition of Streptavidin beads.
Transfer 5 μl of Streptavidin beads to a new 1.5 ml tube per sample.
Wash Streptavidin beads three times with 100 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Resuspend Streptavidin beads in 5 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Transfer resuspended Streptavidin beads to the supernatant from Step 25.
Incubate the tube at room temperature for 30 min, mixing every 5 min.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Wash beads once with 200 μl of BSA solution.
Resuspend Streptavidin beads in 9 μl of nuclease-free water.
Transfer resuspended Streptavidin beads to a new PCR tube.
Add 3.5 μl of TdT mixture directly to the PCR tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 8 min, then 70 °C for 10 min in a thermal cycler.
Add 0.5 μl of 10 μM second strand primer to the PCR tube.
Add 0.5 μl of 10 μM primer A to the PCR tube.
Add 12.5 μl of 2 × KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix directly to the PCR tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down for 20 times.
Run PCR program: 98 °C for 3 min; 98 °C for 15 s, 50 °C for 20 s, 72 °C for 30 s, 14-18 cycles; 72 °C for 5 min.
Place the PCR tube into a magnetic stand for 2 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a 1.5 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube.
Add 46.8 μl of Ampure XP beads to the LoBind tube.
Pipette samples up and down 20-30 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash Ampure XP beads twice with 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 13 μl of nuclease-free water.
Pipette samples up and down 20-30 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a new PCR tube.
Add IVT reaction mixture (2 μl of 10 × Reaction buffer, 2 μl of NTP mix, 1 μl of 0.1 M DTT, 0.5 μl of RNase Inhibitor, 2 μl of T7 Polymerase) to the PCR tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 24 hours.
Add DNase I mixture (3 μl of 10 × TURBO buffer, 1 μl of TURBO enzyme, 6 μl of water) to the IVT solution.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Transfer the reaction mixture to a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube.
Add 66 μl of Agencourt RNA Clean beads (2.2: 1 ratio) to the 1.5 ml tube.
Pipette samples up and down 20-30 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash RNA Clean beads twice with 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% ethanol
Resuspend RNA Clean beads in 13 μl of nuclease-free water.
Pipette samples up and down 20-30 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Place the LoBind tube into a magnetic stand for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new PCR tube.
Take 1 μl of sample for RNA quantification using Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit.
Add 1 μl of 10 μM P7 primer to the PCR tube.
Heat at 65°C for 5 min.
Snap-chill it on ice for 2 min.
Add RT mixture (4 μl of 5 × first strand buffer, 1 μl of 0.1 M DTT, 0.5 μl of Superscript II, 0.5 μl of RNase inhibitor, and 1 μl of dNTP mix (10 mM)) to the PCR tube.
Incubate at 42 °C for 50 min.
Incubate at 70 °C for 15 min.
Hold at 12 °C.

Add PCR mixture (1 μl of 10 μM P7 primer, 1 μl of 10 μM P5 index primer, 3 μl of 10 × Pfx Buffer, 1 μl of 50 mM MgSO4, 0.6 μl of dNTP (25 mM each), 0.8 μl of Pfx enzyme, 2.6 µl of water) to cDNA product.
Run PCR program: 94 °C for 3 min.
Run PCR program: 94 °C for 15 s.
Run PCR program: 62 °C for 30 s.
Run PCR program: 72 °C for 30 s, 8-12 cycles.
Run PCR program: 72 °C for 10 min.
Fractionate PCR product on a 2% agarose gel at 120 V for 2 h until the Orange G dye reaches the bottom of the gel.
Cut out the fragments between 130 bp and 300 bp from the gel.
Transfer the cut-out fragments to a new 2 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube.
Extract DNA using Gel Extraction Kit.
Elute the extracted DNA in 16 μl of elution buffer.
Quantify the library using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Sequence the LACE-seq library with Illumina HiSeq 2500 or NextSeq500 in single-end mode.
Grow cells in 10 cm Petri dishes to reach 80% confluence, then rinse twice with 5 ml of ice-cold 1 × PBS.
Place the dish on ice without a cover and irradiate cells with UV-C light at 400 mJ two times.
Scrape the cross-linked cells off into 5 ml of 1 × PBS and transfer to a 50 ml centrifugation tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, then discard the supernatant.
Store the cross-linked samples at -80 °C or proceed directly to the next step if ready.
Mix protein A/G magnetic beads thoroughly before use and place 40 µl of beads into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube for each sample.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of BSA/PBS solution (0.1% BSA in 1×PBS).
Block the beads with 500 μl of blocking buffer at room temperature for 1 hour, rotating at 20 rpm.
Place the microcentrifuge tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the blocked beads once with 500 µl of Na-phosphate buffer.
Resuspend the washed beads with 200 µl of Na-phosphate buffer containing 10-15 µg specific antibody.
Rotate at 20 rpm for 1 h at RT.
Spin down the beads to the bottom of the microcentrifuge tube with an IKA mini G centrifuge for 5 s.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of wash buffer.
Resuspend in 40 µl of wash buffer per sample.
Leave the beads on ice for addition to the cross-linked lysate.
Lye cross-linked cells on ice using 500 µl of wash buffer for 10 min.
Add 10 µl of SUPERase·In RNase inhibitor and 50 µl of RQ1 DNase to the cell lysate.
Digest genomic DNA at 37 °C for 3 min in ThermoMixer C.
Snap-chill the tube on ice for 3 min.
Aliquot 40 µl of antibody-coupled beads from Step 9 into cell lysate prepared at Step 11.
Rotate at 20 rpm/min for 1 h at 4 °C.
Spin briefly and place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads three times with 500 µl of ice-cold wash buffer.
Wash once with 500 µl of high-salt wash buffer.
Wash once with 500 µl of PNK buffer.
Add 1 μl of diluted MNase to 499 μl of 1 × MN buffer.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 10 min with intermittent mixing every 3 min.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of 1 × PNK + EGTA buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of wash buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of PNK buffer.
Resuspend thoroughly washed beads in 100 μl FastAP mixture and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min with intermittent mixing every 3 min.
Discard the supernatant after incubation.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of 1 × PNK + EGTA buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of PNK buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500 µl of BSA solution.
Resuspend beads in 30 μl ligation mixture and incubate at 25 °C for 2.5 h with intermittent vortexing every 3 min.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand after incubation and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads three times with 500 µl of PNK buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl of nuclease-free water and 1 μl of 10 μM T7-RT primer.
Transfer the 21 μl beads mixture to a new PCR tube, heat at 65 °C for 5 min, and snap-chill on ice for 2 min.

Add RT mixture (6 μl of 5 × first-strand buffer, 0.5 μl of 0.1 M DTT, 1 μl of Superscript II, 0.5 μl of RNase inhibitor, 1 μl of dNTP mix (10 mM)) to the PCR tube and mix by pipetting up and down for 20 times.
Incubate the PCR tube at 42 °C for 50 min, then at 70 °C for 15 min, and hold at 12 °C in a thermal cycler.
Add 4 μl of 10 × Exonuclease I buffer, 3 μl of Exonuclease I, and 3 μl of nuclease-free water directly into the tube. Mix and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h, then at 80 °C for 20 min.

Release the first-strand cDNA from Protein A/G beads by adding 10 μl of RNase H reaction mixture (5 μl of 10 × RNase H buffer, 2 μl of RNase H, 3 μl of nuclease-free water) to the PCR tube. Mix briefly and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, then at 65 °C for 20 min.
Place the PCR tube on a magnetic stand for 1 min and transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube. Keep the tube on ice.
Transfer 10 μl of Streptavidin beads to a new 1.5 ml tube per sample.
Wash three times with 200 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Resuspend Streptavidin beads in 10 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Transfer the resuspended beads to the supernatant from Step 26.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min, occasionally mixing every 5 min.
Place the tube into a magnetic stand for 1 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 μl of 1 × B & W buffer.
Wash beads once with 200 μl of BSA solution.
Resuspend Streptavidin beads in 14.5 μl of nuclease-free water and transfer to a new PCR tube.
Add 5.5 μl of TdT mixture directly to the PCR tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.
Incubate at 70 °C for 10 min in a thermal cycler.
Add 1 μl of 10 μM second strand primer, 1 μl of 10 μM P5 index primer, and 20 μl of 2 × KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix directly to the PCR tube.
Mix by pipetting up and down for 20 times.
Run PCR program at 98 °C for 3 min.
Run PCR cycles: 98 °C for 15 s, 55 °C for 20 s, and 72 °C for 30 s, repeated for 10-14 cycles.
Incubate at 72 °C for 5 min.
Fractionate PCR product on a 2% agarose gel at 120 V for 2 h until the Orange G dye reaches the bottom of the gel.
Cut out the fragments between 130 bp and 300 bp from the gel.
Transfer the cut fragments to a new 2 ml LoBind microcentrifuge tube.
Extract DNA with Gel Extraction Kit (Qiagen).
Elute in 16 μl of elution buffer.
Quantify the library by Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Sequence the LACE-seq library with Illumina HiSeq 2500 or NextSeq500 using single-end mode.
